# Best slim Qi2/MagSafe power banks for iPhone 17

**Best all-round slim pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)**
- It's 0.34" thick and 4.3 oz, with 5,000mAh and Qi2-certified 15W wireless charging. Anker markets it as a best fit for the iPhone 17 series.
- 9to5Mac's reviewer has used it and calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery. They say it feels premium and runs cooler than competitors.
- Price: $54.99 at [Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank), per Anker's page.
- A 5K bank typically recharges a phone about 60-75% ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)).

**Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K)**
- Android Central found it the thinnest and lightest of the slim banks it tested: 0.27" and 104 g.
- Its wireless speed is only 7.5W, so it's slower than the Anker for the same capacity. Its wired output is 22.5W.
- Price: $52.99 at Amazon, listed up to $69.99 elsewhere ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)).

**Best slim with more capacity and speed: INIU SnapGo Air (10K, 25W Qi2.2)**
- It's 0.5" thick and 195 g. Macworld lists it as tied for the slimmest 10K MagSafe bank.
- The iPhone 17 supports 25W Qi2.2, so you get the full wireless speed. Wired charging is 45W, and a lanyard-style 60W cable is included.
- Price: $42.99 at Amazon ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)). Macworld also covers it ([review roundup](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)).
- It has no kickstand.

**Other options**
- **TORRAS MiniMag Pro (10K, 15W):** At 0.57" it's thicker, but it has IP54 dust and water resistance. It costs $69.99 at Amazon ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)).
- **Kuxiu S4 (10K, 25W):** Macworld lists it as tied for the slimmest 10K, with a kickstand and display ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)).

## Which to choose
- **Pocketability and fast wireless charging:** Anker Nano 5K.
- **Thinnest and lightest, and you don't mind slower wireless:** Baseus Picogo Air.
- **Two full charges, still fairly slim, and the best value:** INIU SnapGo Air 10K.

Some of these prices come from review roundups and may have changed, so check the current price before buying. Thick or non-magnetic cases can weaken the connection. Anker's page says cases over 2.5 mm may interfere.
